minutes.headline: Sewer Commission backed the FY22 budget drawing down retained earnings and approved the town meeting articles.
minutes.summary: The commission reviewed the FY22 sewer budget and argued that the retained earnings projection must include the planned draw from retained earnings, not just betterment income versus debt service. Members agreed to have it revised and sent before Thursday's Finance Committee presentation. They approved the standard warrant articles and prior minutes, noted Carl Luck's resignation after 15 years, and discussed Elizabeth Street inflow and Leominster billing.

budget_items.topic: Projected retained earnings, betterment income vs debt service
budget_items.what_was_said: A spreadsheet projected retained earnings using only betterment income against debt service, with a low point in 2023 or 2024.
Members said the projection omitted the planned draw from retained earnings and should show about 1.4 to 1.5 million at end of FY22.
A surplus before the betterment deficit last year was to be added back into the projection.
Nearly 80 percent of expenditures sat in one miscellaneous line; the Finance Committee slides break it down, led by Leominster and Fitchburg direct costs.

what_happened.line: The commission said the FY22 retained earnings projection left out the planned draw from retained earnings, and agreed to have it revised.
The revised projection and the full presentation are to go to commissioners before Thursday's Finance Committee presentation.
The commission accepted the standard sewer warrant articles for the May town meeting; the vote outcome was not audible in the captions.
The FY22 budget shows a deficit between current-year revenue and expenses, covered by an appropriation from retained earnings.
Elizabeth Street inflow and a pump station flow analysis were referred to future agendas; the next meeting is March 30 at 5 pm.

why_it_matters: Sewer rates and the reserve behind them depend on how fast retained earnings are drawn down, and the first projection showed only betterment income against debt service, not the planned draw.
Inflow from one property is adding to the Leominster charges the sewer fund pays each year, and the Finance Committee and May town meeting will see the budget and articles built on these figures.
watch_next: The revised retained earnings projection, due to commissioners before Thursday's Finance Committee presentation.
Next regular meeting March 30 at 5 pm, then April 13, remote until further notice.
